reason: A Windows DSH tool plugin that exposes Git for Windows Bash for model-driven shell command execution, with working-directory, timeout, background-job, and sandbox-related controls.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 模型提供基于 Git for Windows Bash 的终端命令执行工具。
summaries.en: Provides DSH models with a Windows terminal tool for executing commands through Git for Windows Bash.

capabilities: Executes Git Bash shell commands on Windows
Supports configurable working directories and command timeouts
Supports background jobs with returned job identifiers
Can request sandbox permission escalation when configured
